0022600091.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Houston Rockets host the Dallas Mavericks, and Houston will be without Steven Adams, who is out with calf soreness. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the most recent meeting, on January 31, 2026 in Houston, went to the Rockets 111-107.
